decisive_items: diffusely enlarged, sausage-shaped pancreas with delayed enhancement and a capsule-like rim
diffuse pancreatic enlargement with low T1 signal, slightly high T2 signal, and high diffusion-weighted imaging signal
stenosis of the lower bile duct and diffuse narrowing of the main pancreatic duct
response.rationale: The combination of diffuse sausage-shaped pancreatic enlargement, capsule-like rim, delayed enhancement, and diffuse main pancreatic duct narrowing is classic for autoimmune pancreatitis. Elevated CA19-9 and PET-avid nodes are nonspecific and can be seen in AIP, while normal IgG4 does not exclude it.

rejected.why: Elevated CA19-9 and hypermetabolic nodes are nonspecific; the absence of a discrete mass and presence of diffuse sausage-shaped enlargement with a capsule-like rim strongly favor autoimmune pancreatitis over pancreatic cancer.

Chronic pancreatitis can cause ductal narrowing and enzyme elevation, but the diffusely enlarged sausage-shaped pancreas with capsule-like rim and diffuse main duct narrowing are highly characteristic of autoimmune pancreatitis rather than ordinary chronic pancreatitis.
